title: PAR-20/7G.3 EVALUATION_GRAPH expression-target closure
scope: Close the ordinary DXF EVALUATION_GRAPH node-to-expression handle gap with a generated fail-closed control.
Retain the ASCII/Binary owner, NOD identity, cardinality, expression-target, and atomic-publication checks in the existing selector.

sourceChange.change: prepareExtensionObjectGraph now indexes source BLOCK_RECORD and top-level entity handles when ordinary EvaluationGraph objects are present, then requires every node's expression handle to resolve to an inventoried source object/entity before publication. The generated ASCII and Binary controls mutate a valid LINE expression edge to a missing handle and require strict export refusal, the exact graph diagnostic, and preservation of an existing destination sentinel.
sourceChange.reason: A test-first mutation showed that writeEvaluationGraph remapped an unknown group-360 expression handle by identity and emitted the dangling reference. The existing adapter route already asserts that a valid expression resolves to exactly one LINE, so the missing-target refusal closes that same source-backed graph edge without claiming expression semantics beyond handle identity.
